result.rationale: The diff shows Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host assigns params[:embeddable_host][:host] with no presence/nil check, and the new EmbeddableHost model's before_validation calls self.host.sub! which raises NoMethodError on nil. So a malformed request (missing embeddable_host key or null host) yields a 500 instead of the render_json_error 4xx path used for other invalid input. Mechanism is verifiable in the diff; it's an admin-only robustness defect, so severity is modest.

judged_text: save_host dereferences params[:embeddable_host][:host] with no presence check, so a request missing the embeddable_host key (nil[:host]) or carrying a null host (EmbeddableHost's before_validation then calls self.host.sub! on nil, app/models/embeddable_host.rb:6) raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 where the contract promises a 4xx validation error. Any staff member POSTing/PUTing an embeddable host without the embeddable_host payload (or with a null host) triggers a server-side NoMethodError and a 500 instead of the 422 render_json_error path the rest of the controller uses for invalid input.

adjudication.rationale: In Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host, the code unconditionally does `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` (new file app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb). If `params[:embeddable_host]` is missing, this will raise `NoMethodError` (`nil[:host]`) and return a 500 instead of reaching the `host.save` / `render_json_error` path. Additionally, even if `embeddable_host` exists but `:host` is nil, EmbeddableHost's `before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb) which will also raise on nil before validations can add errors. This matches the finding’s described failure mode.
